snippet.title: Gauntlet III - The Final Quest (amiga)
snippet.description:
I ran out of video near the end of the second "realm". Apparently there are total of eight realms.

Not very difficult, but not very fun either.

Copyright: Tengen
Publisher: U.S. Gold (1991)
